set.body: Generalize and rename the existing as_image_matrix() in R/scale_space_utils.R into as_subject_matrix(). Broaden the input contract to cover: list<array>, list<NeuroVol>, NeuroVec (note: as.matrix(NeuroVec) is n_voxels x n_volumes — must transpose), SparseNeuroVec (use intrinsic mask; supplied mask may further restrict but error if it leaves the intrinsic mask), and matrix (with mask + template). Return structure(list(X, mask, mask_idx, template, dims, coords, space, source), class='neurothresh_image_matrix'). Mask precedence is strict: NULL = infer finite intersection (or sparse intrinsic); supplied = use exactly that domain, error on non-finite or out-of-sparse-mask voxels. Promotion: mask -> LogicalNeuroVol and template -> NeuroVol only when the input carries NeuroSpace; plain arrays stay plain. No S4 in the first slice — plain exported function with type branches. Acceptance: identical X, mask_idx, and reconstructed stat_vol across all five input types for the same toy data. See specs/api-consistency-plan.md §9. Phase 1 (factory rename) is blocked by this.
set.title: [apicon] Phase 1b: as_subject_matrix() polymorphic input layer
